name: Multiple Choice (Single Answer)
summary: Question with 2-6 answer options; user taps one. Immediate feedback. Points for correctness ± speed.

aiGenerability.notes: Most mature format. LLMs excel at creating questions with plausible distractors. AI can generate questions with pedagogically sound distractors that reflect common misconceptions.

question.description: The question text posed to the learner.

correctIndex.description: 0-based index of the correct answer in the options array.

explanation.description: Optional explanation of the correct answer shown after selection.

ux.mobileNotes: Large tap targets stacked vertically. Color coding (green=correct, red=incorrect) visible even on small screens. Avoid text-only options; use icons + text when possible.

ageAdaptations.8-10: Maximum 4 options. Positive-only feedback (avoid harsh 'wrong'). Larger 56x56px touch targets. Simple, concrete language. Use icons + color coding.
ageAdaptations.11-13: Up to 5 options. Constructive feedback explaining misconceptions. Standard 48x48px targets. Longer, more complex questions allowed.
ageAdaptations.14-16: Up to 6 options. Timed variant available (10-15s countdown). Challenging distractors. Can include contextual follow-up explanation.
